content.short: Privacy layer that keeps balances, payments and identity checks private on public blockchains.
content.description: TACEO adds sub-second cryptographic privacy to existing chains through one API, without moving users to a separate private network. Its Merces product, now live on mainnet, provides private balances, payments and yield with compliance and audit controls, and nobody, including TACEO, sees the plaintext. The same network powers private identity verification for more than 18 million users and confidential x402 payments for AI agents.
content.meta: TACEO brings private balances, payments and identity checks to public chains via one API, used by 18M+ users.
